title: Fix review findings on the remote directory picker
body:
Fix the review findings on the remote directory picker (commit c135e73: src/remote_browse.rs, src/remote_browse_ui.rs, src/remote_dir_prompt.rs, src/remotes_pane.rs). A design review refused sign-off on four points and a code review added two should-fixes. No new features beyond what is listed.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (the directory picker part). Feature doc: docs/remote-sessions.md.
Blocked by: Remote directory picker in the directory prompt and the Remotes pane
Must fix:
1. Failures are cached for the life of the widget. Cache::get returns a stored Failed forever, so one ssh timeout, "connection refused" or the needs-login result sticks to that directory until the prompt is cancelled and reopened (for example the key is added to the agent while the form is open and the list still says it needs a password). Do not keep transport failures (the Err from run, or outcome falling through to classify_failure): re-ask when the user enters the list again or changes directory, and offer a visible "retry" row or action with a key. Keep script-level results (missing, not a directory, denied) cached. Every failure line says what to do ("Type the path instead."), and raw ssh stderr is not shown as the whole message.
2. The truncation notice is invisible: Browser::show draws "Only the first 500 folders" after all 500 rows inside the scroll area. Put it on the breadcrumb line outside the scroll ("Folders in /x - first 500").
3. In the Remotes pane form the list is detached from its row: show_form draws one list area after ALL Directory rows and the breadcrumb names only the remote path, so with several Projects the focused field and its list are far apart and one scrolls out of view at minimum height. Name the Project in the list area ("Folders for <project> on <remote>"), and scroll so the focused field and the list area are both visible when they fit.
4. Down in the form depends on timing: browse_key enters the list only when has_rows, so during Loading the same key moves to the next field and 200 ms later enters the list. While the focused Directory's listing is Loading, Down must not move to the next field: enter the list and select the first row when it arrives.
5. Nothing executes the Posix listing script under test; tests only assert its text. Add a test that runs `sh -c <script>` (the real generated script) against a temp directory containing hostile names (-x, it's, $(x), a name with a newline, .hidden, a plain file, a symlink to a directory) and asserts the parsed entries; skip it cleanly when `sh` is not on PATH (Windows dev boxes have Git Bash). Also run the cap and each fail branch (missing, not a directory, denied where the platform allows).
Also fix (small):
- posix_script prints `dir $(pwd)` with no newline guard, so a resolved path containing a newline can forge a row or an early end marker. Guard it in the script or reject it in the parser.
- parse strips a trailing CR from Posix names (a folder named "x\r" becomes "x" and then fails to open); strip CR only for PowerShell output. Names that are not valid UTF-8 cannot be chosen: show them dimmed and unselectable with a hover note instead of a broken name. Do not paint bidi-override or other control characters from a name; show a visible placeholder.
- Typing while the list is focused is dropped silently: route printable text back to the field (focus the field and append it).
- Esc differs between the two hosts: in the prompt it cancels the whole prompt from the list, in the form it only leaves the list. Make the first Esc in the list return to the field in both; the second cancels. Update both hints.
- The prompt's list hint never says how to open ("Tab, then Enter open"). A focused list with no rows (after descending into a Loading or Failed directory) still shows the row hint; hand focus back to the field on Failed.
- Loading has no elapsed cue: after about 3 seconds say it is still trying, with the Remote's name. Do not show Loading during the debounce before anything runs.
- Rows: use the launcher's row height and its hover fill so the list reads like the app's other lists; "Focus a Directory..." idle copy becomes plain ("Click a Directory field to browse folders on <remote>").
- No cancel on close: a closed prompt or form leaves its ssh child running up to the deadline. Kill in-flight listings when the widget is dropped, and cap concurrent listings (2 is enough).
- Frame cost: the list paints up to 500 rows every frame with clones and a layout job each; use ScrollArea::show_rows and build the View once per frame.
- PowerShell side (still labelled untested): list_line must respect WINDOWS_LINE_CAP with a plain message, and Get-PSDrive sits outside the try so a throw ends the script without the end marker.
- Stale reseat/want after a navigation lands on a Failed directory moves the selection on a later unrelated listing; clear them.
You may run read-only listings against andy@100.102.251.37 (key login, never ask for a password). Do not write anything there.
Done when:
- unit tests for each must-fix (transport failure is retried, script failure stays cached; truncation shown on the breadcrumb line; form area names the Project; Down during Loading stays and selects on arrival; the executed-script test)
- egui::Context::run tests: list height unchanged across all states including the retry state; first Esc returns to the field in both hosts; typing with the list focused lands in the field
- the full test suite passes
- the final report lists the states the human should capture with build-screenshot
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
